actions.script: def payment=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.pos.KotServices.complete#KotBill') .parameters(['sessionId','kotId','confirmedTotal','paymentMethod','cashAmount','cardAmount','upiAmount', 'customerName','customerPhone','referenceNumber','cardRef','upiRef','creditCustomerPartyId', 'upfrontAmount','upfrontMethod','creditDays','termsReason'].collectEntries { [(it):ec.context[it]] }).call()?.checkout ec.web.sendJsonResponse(payment ?: [success:false,error:ec.message.errorsString ?: 'Could not complete this order.'])

def workspace=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.pos.KotOfflineServices.export#KotWorkspace') .parameter('sessionId',ec.context.sessionId).call()?.workspace ec.web.sendJsonResponse(workspace ? [success:true,workspace:workspace] : [success:false,error:ec.message.errorsString ?: 'KOT offline setup is unavailable.'])

def summary = ec.service.sync().name('zenith.pos.KotServices.get#BillingSession') .parameters([sessionId:ec.context.sessionId,includeBillSummary:true]).call()?.billSummary ec.web.sendJsonResponse(summary ? [success:true,summary:summary] : [success:false,error:ec.message.errorsString ?: 'Could not refresh the bill summary.'])
